subject: Mutual Action Plan & next steps (Acme)
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwoodinference.com>
To: Jordan Smith <jordan@acme.com>, Priya Singh <priya@acme.com>
Cc: Rafael Mendes <rafael@redwoodinference.com>, Aisha Rahman <aisha@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Fri, 05 Dec 2026 09:14:00 -0800
Subject: Recap + Mutual Action Plan (MAP) - Redwood x Acme POC

Hi Jordan + Priya -

Thanks again for the time this morning. Quick recap from our discovery and the MAP I promised to share. High-level notes below, followed by proposed milestones and owners. I attached a one-page MAP and an initial SOW draft for your procurement team to review.

Key pain / context
- Current latency on Acme search infra is causing degraded UX for power users (~800-1200ms p95) and blocking feature launches.
- Cost is unclear across peak hours; your infra team is seeing unexpectedly high token costs on the QA cluster.
- Security/compliance: need SOC2 evidence and VPC deployment option for production.

Goals (3-6 months)
1) Reduce p95 tail latency to <300ms for the search scenario.
2) Validate cost savings with dedicated inference capacity vs. current setup.
3) Get security checklist sign-off so we can deploy to a VPC for production testing.

Proposed MAP (milestones, owners, dates)
- Week 1 (Dec 7): Sandbox access + example workload (Jordan) - Acme provides sample query set and a representative VM.
- Week 2 (Dec 14): POC deployment in Redwood sandbox + initial latency/cost baseline (Marissa + Rafael).
- Week 4 (Dec 28): Performance tuning and quantization options evaluated; preliminary cost model (Marissa).
- Week 6 (Jan 11): Security review and SOC2 artifacts handed to Acme security (Aisha).
- Week 8 (Jan 25): Executive review and decision checkpoint (Jordan + Priya).

Stakeholders
- Acme: Jordan Smith (Search eng lead), Priya Singh (Head of Product), + procurement (TBD)
- Redwood: Marissa Cole (AM), Rafael Mendes (Solutions Eng), Aisha Rahman (Security/compliance lead)

Open questions / risks
- Do you have a strict procurement cut-off date for January approvals?
- Will the Acme security team require an on-prem package or is VPC sufficient for the first release?

Next steps
1) Jordan: share sample query set and a contact for the infra VM by Monday (Dec 7).
2) I’ll schedule the POC kickoff with Rafael and send calendar invites once we have the sample data.
3) Aisha will start pulling SOC2 evidence and will share a requested docs list.

Attachments: Redwood_Acme_MAP_v1.pdf, SOW-draft.pdf

Appreciate the time - I’ll follow up with calendar invites for the Week 1 kickoff.

Best,

Marissa Cole
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
marissa@redwoodinference.com
(415) 555-0123

Subject: Re: Recap + Mutual Action Plan (MAP) - Redwood x Acme POC

Marissa - thanks for the clear recap. Agree with the goals and milestones. A few quick answers:

- I can share the sample query set and the VM contact by end of day Monday (Dec 7).
- Procurement: we have an internal review window that needs vendor terms signed by the last week of January. If we want to close in Jan, we should have the exec review by Jan 25 as you noted.
- Security: VPC is preferred to start; on-prem will be discussed later if needed.

I’ve looped in Priya to confirm product requirements and procurement timing. Priya - any additions to scope we should account for?

Jordan
